propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) that do not exist in the live REB Jira Cloud.

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot iterates over every key in projects.json and issues jql_active queries; when a key does not exist in Jira, the query fails with a parse error and reconcile_once aborts.
The Reconcile Bridge scheduled GitHub Action has failed every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z with error 'failed to parse JQL query: the value LEG does not exist for the field project'.
The corruption was introduced by ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e) authored with test-fixture identity, violating the write-lock and commit-publish contract.
Restoring projects.json to the canonical state {version: 1, legacy_default: REB, projects: {}} fixes the issue and allows bridge preview and scheduled runs to complete successfully.
